title: MCP hub: searchable catalog and connected-server dashboard

checks.check: the dialog is a hub: one tablist with three tabs
checks.detail: tabs: Catalog, Connected, Activity

checks.check: each tab controls its own panel, and the panels are tabpanels
checks.detail: panels: Catalog, Connected, Activity · aria-controls and aria-labelledby wired both ways

checks.check: the landing tab is the catalog, not the configuration form
checks.detail: Catalog is selected and Connected starts hidden

checks.check: switching a tab shows exactly one panel and moves the roving tabindex
checks.detail: switchMcpTab() hides every other panel, sets aria-selected and a single tab stop

checks.check: the tab strip answers the arrow keys, Home and End
checks.detail: one delegated listener bound when the hub opens; no inline key handler in the markup

checks.check: the dialog is a labelled modal
checks.detail: role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled by the hub title

checks.check: the hub has one search box that names what it searches
checks.detail: type=search, labelled, re-renders the hub on input

checks.check: the catalog filters count what they would show
checks.detail: each chip is a toggle with a count and aria-pressed

checks.check: search narrows the cards and hides the rows that do not match
checks.detail: applyMcpHubSearch() hides every row whose haystack misses the term

checks.check: a search with no hit says so and offers to clear itself
checks.detail: the empty state names the term and offers a Clear search action

checks.check: a preset is a card, not a chip with a name
checks.detail: mcpCatalogCardHtml() renders a named card with its target

checks.check: every card states its transport, trust, key requirement and policy
checks.detail: remote/local · trust · key requirement · approval policy on every card

checks.check: the transport says remote HTTP or local stdio in words
checks.detail: a pill, not a colour or an icon alone

checks.check: the key requirement names the variable or says no key is needed
checks.detail: either `No key needed` or the exact environment variable

checks.check: trust is derived from the stored preset, never invented
checks.detail: mcpPresetTrust() reads requires_token and approval_policy only

checks.check: the card says whether it is connected and what its button will do
checks.detail: state line plus a Use preset / Review action

checks.check: cards show the endpoint or the command they would run
checks.detail: remote cards print the URL, stdio cards print command and arguments

checks.check: the configuration form is a shut disclosure, not the first thing shown
checks.detail: the editor is a closed <details> with a summary that says what it is

checks.check: a card opens the editor for you and lands on the Connected tab
checks.detail: selectMcpPreset() and editMcpServer() both open the editor on Connected

checks.check: the editor describes what is actually in it, not the card that filled it
checks.detail: syncMcpEditorState() reads the alias and picks preset / editing / new

checks.check: connected rows state transport, policy and their sync note
checks.detail: each row carries its search key, its tools and the error it really got

checks.check: the connected list explains itself when nothing is connected
checks.detail: the empty state points at the Catalog tab

checks.check: every control the old dialog had is still on the hub
checks.detail: 20 controls:

checks.check: all three approval policies survive, on the form and on the rows
checks.detail: auto / inherit / always_ask kept in the select and in the per-server row

checks.check: Activity reports every server's health, not just the happy ones
checks.detail: state pill, policy, tool counts, token mask and the stored sync note per server

checks.check: a test call is recorded with its outcome, its latency and a capped detail
checks.detail: both the success and the failure path record, and the detail is capped at 160 characters

checks.check: the activity log is bounded and newest first
checks.detail: unshift with a 12-entry cap

checks.check: the tab counts are computed from the state, not typed in
checks.detail: catalog / connected / activity counts read the live arrays

checks.check: no renderer interpolates a secret into the page
checks.detail: renderers: only masked values

checks.check: the only credential the hub renders is the server's mask
checks.detail: masked_token in the connected row and in Activity

checks.check: saving empties the token field
checks.detail: the typed secret does not stay in the DOM after a save

checks.check: the served payload is what masks the secret, not the page
checks.detail: app.py sends masked_token; the hub never sees the raw value

checks.check: the six MCP routes are unchanged and none were added
checks.detail: 6 routes, no additions

checks.check: spawning a stdio command is still gated on the operator's opt-in
checks.detail: STUDIO_ALLOW_MCP_STDIO is still required before a command is launched

checks.check: the workspace still has all six tabs
checks.detail: start, harness, hall, council, debate, chat

checks.check: the top strip still shows the MCP pill row and its tool count
checks.detail: the strip is outside the dialog and untouched

checks.check: a browser walk asserts the hub on a screen
checks.detail: mcp_hub_walk.mjs: 40 recorded checks

checks.check: the walk covers every state the ledger asks for
checks.detail: STATES = catalog, search, connected, secrets, activity, loading, long, error

checks.check: the walk connects a real stdio server rather than inventing one
checks.detail: the fixture speaks the protocol; the fixture app opts into stdio launch explicitly

checks.check: the walk refuses to photograph the hub with a fake secret
checks.detail: the secret is typed into the form and then searched for in the document

checks.check: captures exist for every viewport and theme, with a before set
checks.detail: 88 after PNG, 88 before PNG
